note: Alberta Parks recreation area campground on the west shore of Fawcett Lake, a 55-minute drive from Slave Lake. Treed sites close to the lakeshore; hand boat launch, fish-cleaning station and day-use area. No firewood on site, and the hand pump is for putting out fires only, so bring drinking water. --Claude
summary: Read the AP camping page (Sep 25, 2026), the shop and the Jan 2026 tear sheet: C$25, seniors' discount, May 14 - Oct 11, closed for winter Oct 13 2026 and on the shop through May 20 2027; FIRST-COME ONLY (stored reservable/some_sites -> not reservable, fcfs always; only the group site books); 28 unserviced, pit toilets, no showers, pump water for fires only, no firewood. Website: give the camping page. Lakeview: recommend DOWN to not waterfront.

The tear sheet strings sites 15-28 along the main road north of the boat launch and sites 1-14 on a loop west of the road; on the 2025-05-26 Esri capture the main road and its east-side spur run ~70-130 m from the shoreline through continuous dense forest, with no pads or clearings visible near the water. The stored evidence's 'open grassy pad clearings ~20-40 m off the water' matches the mown fields at the south end, which the tear sheet marks as the day-use/boat-launch and group-camping area, not campsites. The shop tags only the group site 'Near Water'. No view of the lake through that forest can be confirmed: go down.

TWO SECTIONS (not a split as read): the page says 'This campground consists of two camping sections located approximately 2 kilometres apart.' The January 2026 tear sheet shows sites 1-14 and 15-28 contiguous along one road within ~1 km of the launch, so the 2 km is not borne out by the map; no separate campground found. The DB holds only this entry for Fawcett Lake.
